vda5050_order — DRIVE agv op

• Data kinds: table → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.vda5050_order(path, *, order_id='order-1', order_update_id=0, cell_size=1.0, map_id='floor', allowed_xy=0.05, allowed_theta=0.087, max_speed=1.0, released_nodes=None) (to call the implementation directly, import agvfleet; agvfleet.vda5050_order(path, *, order_id='order-1', order_update_id=0, cell_size=1.0, map_id='floor', allowed_xy=0.05, allowed_theta=0.087, max_speed=1.0, released_nodes=None); from the registry, opsdrive.get("vda5050_order"))

Usage

Turns the plan of 1 vehicle (sequence of cells) into a VDA 5050 order (dict). Waits are removed, and the cell centers become nodes.

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

ノードの sequenceId は 0, 2, 4 …(偶数)、エッジは 1, 3, 5 …(奇数)、エッジ数 = ノード数 − 1。released_nodes 個までを base(released=True)、残りを horizon にする(既定 = 全部 base)。座標は x = col * cell_size、y = −row * cell_size(行は下向き、地図の y は上向き)。
